_comment: iOS 2.2.1 (5H11a) overlay on rootfs/recipe.json. Applied by scripts/versions.py into build/fw-2.2.1/recipe.json; the 4.2.1 recipe is never changed. 2.x has no dyld shared cache (frameworks are individual dylibs) and no MBXGLEngine/Substrate, so all cache patches, interposers, Cydia and TLSFix are left out. The liblockdown patches + ldid re-sign were removed after a control run showed the re-sign alone stops dyld after CoreSurface; the stock signed dylib lets it load the full framework set (re-log 115). Activation remains an open item.

_activation: SpringBoard's liblockdown calls end in /var/run/lockdown/localcomm, which does not exist without lockdownd. The stock /usr/lib/liblockdown.dylib is byte-patched in place (connect/checkin/copy_value/copy_identity/disconnect/set/remove stubs and an offline ActivationState table) and keeps its stock signature blob: re-signing it stalls 2.x dyld (re-log 116), and the 2.2.1 kernel patch cs-invalid-page-allow accepts the patched pages instead (re-log 128).
_todo: Darwin 9 lacks IOSurface, CoreMotion and Celestial's 4.x API: our 4.2.1 GPU/gyro/camera userland binaries cannot simply be copied here. The activation interposer above is the only 4.2.1-derived tool installed on 2.2.1; input/MCU/Wi-Fi tools are still not installed (docs/multi-version.md §6.5).

extra_file_patches.why: 5H11a liblockdown: lockdown_connect -> 1 (fake handle) because __local_connect() to /var/run/lockdown/localcomm fails without lockdownd.

5H11a liblockdown: ARM stub for lockdown_copy_value; walks the key/value table at VA 0x30891544 (patch @0x544) comparing the requested key CFStringRef (r2) by pointer and returns the value, else NULL. Verified 44-byte original body replaced. The first instruction is ldr ip,[pc,#0x20] (the table literal at +0x28); the re-log 114 bytes had #0x14, which loads the 'bx lr' word as the table pointer and faulted every caller at 0x30893c24 (far 0xe12fff1e, re-log 128).

Offline activation table in a verified zero gap of liblockdown __TEXT (VA 0x30891544): ActivationState -> inline CFString 'Activated' (isa __CFConstantStringClassReference 0x38237da0), BrickState -> __kCFBooleanFalse 0x38237524 (the object; re-log 114 stored 0x38241c48, the kCFBooleanFalse *variable*, and objc_msgSend crashed on it, re-log 128). Addresses from 5H11a CoreFoundation's symtab; 2.x dylibs are prebound, never slid. Other keys return NULL as on 4.x.

5H11a lockdown_disconnect -> 0. SpringBoard imports it and passes the fake handle from lockdown_connect (symbol VA 0x30893be4 from liblockdown's own symtab); without this stub it faults on a fake handle.
5H11a lockdown_remove_value -> 0 (symbol VA 0x308940a8; same reason as disconnect).

5H11a lockdown_set_value -> 0 (symbol VA 0x308940f4; same reason as disconnect). All three original byte sequences were verified in this dylib; The dylib keeps its stock signature blob; the 2.2.1 kernel patch cs-invalid-page-allow lets the patched pages load (re-log 128).
5H11a lockdown_checkin -> 0 (ARM: mov r0,#0; bx lr; symbol VA 0x30894144 from the dylib symtab). No lockdownd to check in with; 7E18 stubs the same function.
5H11a lockdown_copy_identity -> NULL (ARM; symbol VA 0x30893c60). No pairing identity offline; 7E18 stubs the same function.

_cydia_pseudo: Cydia stays off on 2.2.1: Cydia 1.1.30's armv6 slice (and the apt7/dpkg builds) use LC_DYLD_INFO_ONLY, which 5H11a's dyld cannot load (re-log 129); the icon showed but a tap launched nothing (re-log 131, 4.1 completeness). A 2.x set needs pre-3.1-linked Cydia/APT packages. The values below apply if one is added.
_gps: Fake GPS (docs/location.md): 2.x builds of ios3ds-applog.dylib, ios3ds-gps, ios3ds-gpstest and ios3ds-diag are installed. CoreLocation hooks work in a process that loads applog; the stock Maps and MobileSafari executables get an LC_LOAD_DYLIB for it (below), because 2.x has no SBGuardMallocAlways and a launchd-wide DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES hangs the boot (re-log 139).
_wifi: Wi-Fi (re-log NEXT): en0 is the shim's own Darwin 9 ifnet (kern.ios3ds_eth, tools/ios3ds-wifi/shim/kif_eth.c) because 5H11a has no IOUserEthernet. It is not an IOKit object, so configd would not create a network service for it: the preferences.plist above holds one Wi-Fi service on en0 with DHCP. configd gets the 2.x a80211 bridge. SpringBoard (and the apps it starts, i.e. Settings' AirPortSettings) also get it: on 2.x they call Apple80211 in-process.
